findings: Duplicate variant selector markup — The color and size selection blocks are repeated identically in both mobile and desktop sections (lines 101–147 and lines 262–308). This violates DRY and creates maintenance risk. Extract into a reusable component or use a flag to conditionally render, not duplicate.

Missing VariantModal test coverage — The modal is wired (setSelectedVariantForModal, isOpen check, onClose handler) but no test file is present to verify the modal opens/closes correctly or that variant filtering inside the modal works.

Potential key collision on Set-derived arrays — Lines using `[...new Set(...)]` to deduplicate colors and sizes create arrays that have no stable key; if the Set deduplication logic ever changes, React re-renders could flicker. Consider using `.map((v, i) => ({ ...v, _key: i }))` to stabilize keys if variants are frequently added/removed.
